subject: Newsletter cooperative: surge credit exception request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DevCommunity newsletter — exceptional credit ask

Hey team,

Quick note: DevCommunity had a guest contributor article run in their weekly newsletter yesterday and delivered ~3x expected CTR. They just asked for an emergency top-up of promo credits for the cohort that converted from that send.

What they asked for: 50,000 trial tokens (in addition to the 10k we already allocated) to cover the surge and avoid turning people away. They say the bulk are unique signups and can provide a hashed list for reconciliation.

Why this matters: this is a high-visibility partner placement — if we can honor a partial exception we get momentum in the partner program and a co-marketing case study. Cost impact if fully granted: roughly $2.5k in marginal hosting/trial spend before any conversion.

Attached: promo_codes.csv (sample format they've requested). HubSpot deal HS-112233 has the engagement notes.

Ask: can we approve an exception for this newsletter cohort this week? If yes, who will own code issuance and tracking?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: promo_codes.csv]
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DevCommunity newsletter — exceptional credit ask

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A couple quick thoughts: 

- I’m OK approving an exception but prefer to stage it: 25k issued immediately, 25k held in a contingency pool to be released after we validate the hashed receipts and dedupe against existing trials.
- We need a tracking plan: tokens must be tagged with channel=devcommunity_newsletter and a campaign id so we can attribute conversions and cap redemptions per account. Ops can generate codes with those metadata tags.
- Finance: I need a budget code to charge the excess to before we push. Laura, can you confirm available promo budget for partner ops this month?

If we approve, I’ll send the first batch to Sonia and ask for the hash file. Please confirm timeline — partner says they'd like codes within 48 hours.

Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@devcommunity.org>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@devcommunity.org
Date: 2027-06-21T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DevCommunity newsletter — exceptional credit ask

Hi Mateo and Marissa,

Thanks for the quick response. We can accept a staged allocation — 25k now, 25k contingent works for us. We will provide a hashed list (SHA256) of the signups within 24 hours so you can reconcile and release the remainder.

Attaching the signed statement of cooperation (signed_mou.pdf) for your records. We also confirm we will enforce one trial redemption per user and can throttle the follow-up send if you prefer.

If you can push the first batch today that would be ideal. Appreciate the support — this placement drove a lot of high-quality traffic.

Best,
Sonia Patel
Head of Partnerships, DevCommunity
[Attachment: signed_mou.pdf]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DevCommunity newsletter — exceptional credit ask

Approved. Finance confirmed partner promo budget for June can absorb up to 30k without rebook, so we will charge the first 25k to partner promo (code: PART-PROMO-06) and mark the remaining 25k as contingent pending reconciliation.

I’ve opened OPS ticket OPS-7894 for code issuance and included the tagging requirements (channel=devcommunity_newsletter, campaign=HS-112233). Ops to deliver code list and cadence.

Next steps:
- Mateo: please confirm final delivery format for promo_codes.csv and the desired prefix for codes.
- Marissa: coordinate with Sonia for the hashed file and confirm the throttle plan.
- Ops: once ticket is updated, generate 25,000 single-use codes and deliver to Mateo and Sonia.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
